pulse_recipe.reason: R5 observed25s WA and29s XC from clear to authorization; do not re-inject during that auth interval
pulse_recipe.initial_probe_relevance: In each ADMIT pulse, remember exactmissingXC validprobe and exactmissingWA broadcast; clear only when each is goodORseen in that same pulse.
pulse_recipe.pulse_counter_scope: No duration decision depends on pulse count; recovery stays2s.
pulse_recipe.later_max_condition: Only ADMIT while WA missing uses max60s; otherwise max2s, all recovery max2s.
pulse_recipe.seen_scope: Reset seen_xc and seen_wa on every pulse start; stale observations never crosspulse.
pulse_recipe.RECOVER_rule: Only exacttarget validprobe consumes window; other3 authorization/session/counters protected.
